theorem lg_target {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Abelian C] {I : C} [CategoryTheory.Injective I] {L : CochainComplex C ℤ} {i : ℤ} (ι : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor C i).obj I ⟶ L) [L.IsStrictlyGE i] [QuasiIsoAt ι i] : CategoryTheory.IsSplitMono ι := by
  have q : QuasiIso ι := QuasiIsoAt.quasiIsoOfQuasiIsoAt ι
  have h : HomologicalComplex.homotopyEquivalences C (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ι := CochainComplex.quasiIso_iff_of_injective _ _ _ _ _ q
  exact CategoryTheory.IsSplitMono.of_quasi_iso_split_mono (CategoryTheory.IsSplitMono.of_quasi_iso_split_mono' h)
